<a id="def-fold-out-rule"></a>
<a id="eq-fold-out-rule"></a>

:::{#def-fold-out-fitted-model}
#### Fold-out fitted model

For [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{\ifold}$,
the **fold-out fitted model** $\fittedwo{\ifold}{\cdot}$
is the [fitted model](#def-fitted-model)
that a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$ produces
from the observations outside that fold:

$$
\fittedwo{\ifold}{\predvar} \eqdef \fitmodvalf{\paren{(\predvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})}_{\iobs \in \obsidx \setminus \fold{\ifold}}}{\predvar}.
$$ {#eq-fold-out-fitted-model}

:::

:::{#rem-source-fold-out-fitted-model}
#### Source: Fold-out fitted model

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1],
who write the fitted function with the $k$th part of the data removed as $\hat f^{-k}$.

:::
